snippet.title: AURATITAN: Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
AURATITAN is a Co-Op run-n-gun / movement platformer hybrid, starring the titular AuraTitans, Kita and Vana! Along the way, They'll be using the many mystical Auras of Shatterstar island to save the world. Their journey wont be easy, however. The evil Dr Isacc Murabito has sent his evil Aura Hunters, each infused with their own elemental Aura to the island. Its up to you to put a stop to his invasion!

Auratitan is my new Indie game ive been making for a year and a half. I recently decided to make a channel to show off WIP gameplay etc of it!

https://bsky.app/profile/software-bunny.bsky.social
